1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Reduction
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.MinusEdge
3 import SixVertexUnfolding.PrismComplete
4 
5 /-! The remaining six-vertex work is confined to universal vertices and the prism with a diagonal. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding
8 
9 /-- The concrete graph labels already certify the exact number of original vertices. -/
10 theorem ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.vertex_count {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph) :
11     P.vertices.card = 6 := by
12   have count := Fintype.card_congr graph.vertex
13   simpa only [P.vertex_card, Fintype.card_fin] using count.symm
14 
15 /-- The complete octahedron case needs no separate assumption on facet sizes. -/
16 theorem every_convex_octahedron (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
17     (octahedral : graph.kind = .octahedron) : P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
18   rcases six_vertex_reduction P graph.vertex_count with unfolded | small_faces
19   · exact unfolded
20   · exact graph.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_octahedron small_faces octahedral
21 
22 /-- The complete single-quadrilateral case also needs no separate facet-size assumption. -/
23 theorem every_convex_octahedron_minus_edge (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
24     (kind : graph.kind = .minusEdge) : P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
25   rcases six_vertex_reduction P graph.vertex_count with unfolded | small_faces
26   · exact unfolded
27   · exact graph.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_minusEdge small_faces kind
28 
29 /-- The complete ordinary-prism case needs no separate assumption on facet sizes or parallelism. -/
30 theorem every_convex_triangular_prism (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
31     (kind : graph.kind = .prism) : P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
32   rcases six_vertex_reduction P graph.vertex_count with unfolded | small_faces
33   · exact unfolded
34   · exact graph.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_prism small_faces kind
35 
36 /-- The completed constructions eliminate the octahedron and its single-quadrilateral variant. -/
37 theorem unfolding_or_universal_or_prism (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (at_most_six : P.vertices.card ≤ 6) :
38     P.HasEdgeUnfolding ∨
39       (P.vertices.card = 6 ∧
40         (∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
41           (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) ∧
42         ((∃ v : P.Vertex, ∀ w, w ≠ v → P.edgeGraph.Adj v w) ∨
43           ∃ graph : P.SixVertexGraph, graph.kind = .prismDiagonal ∨ graph.kind = .prism)) := by
44   rcases unfolding_or_remaining_cases P at_most_six with unfolded | ⟨size, small_faces⟩
45   · exact Or.inl unfolded
46   by_cases universal : ∃ v : P.Vertex, ∀ w, w ≠ v → P.edgeGraph.Adj v w
47   · exact Or.inr ⟨size, small_faces, Or.inl universal⟩
48   obtain ⟨graph⟩ := P.exists_six_vertex_graph size universal small_faces
49   cases kind : graph.kind with
50   | octahedron => exact Or.inl (graph.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_octahedron small_faces kind)
51   | minusEdge => exact Or.inl (graph.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_minusEdge small_faces kind)
52   | prismDiagonal => exact Or.inr ⟨size, small_faces, Or.inr ⟨graph, Or.inl kind⟩⟩
53   | prism => exact Or.inr ⟨size, small_faces, Or.inr ⟨graph, Or.inr kind⟩⟩
54 
55 /-- Every input is now settled except the universal-vertex case and the prism-with-diagonal case. -/
56 theorem unfolding_or_universal_or_prismDiagonal (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (at_most_six : P.vertices.card ≤ 6) :
57     P.HasEdgeUnfolding ∨
58       (P.vertices.card = 6 ∧
59         (∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
60           (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) ∧
61         ((∃ v : P.Vertex, ∀ w, w ≠ v → P.edgeGraph.Adj v w) ∨
62           ∃ graph : P.SixVertexGraph, graph.kind = .prismDiagonal)) := by
63   rcases unfolding_or_universal_or_prism P at_most_six with unfolded | ⟨size, small_faces, cases⟩
64   · exact Or.inl unfolded
65   rcases cases with universal | ⟨graph, kind | kind⟩
66   · exact Or.inr ⟨size, small_faces, Or.inl universal⟩
67   · exact Or.inr ⟨size, small_faces, Or.inr ⟨graph, kind⟩⟩
68   · exact Or.inl (graph.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_prism small_faces kind)
69 
70 end SixVertexUnfolding
